information.description:
Throughout the VDB, certain Netrunners have proven themselves to be such NET-savantes that they’ve been given command over smaller sects, typically for a specific job or to protect vital gang territory. A Manbo can put down most threats with a mere thought, and are extra protected against hostile intrusions. Your best bet is to get in close and put them down before they get a chance to fry your everything.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Voodoo Boys).

description.value: Master hackers who put themselves at risk as they jack into cyberspace to download secrets and infiltrate networks.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

This simple, unpretentious pistol is the pride and joy of Arasaka engineers. Kenshin is one of the most cutting-edge – and deadliest – machine pistols available on the market. The Kenshin's brute power first comes from generating electromagnetic tension, before releasing a lethal, tungsten tipped round that can penetrate the sturdiest armor. Like other guns of this class, it comes ready-equipped with a holographic scope.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Excellent Quality Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst.
